description: Card-funded prepaid credit over an MPP method="stripe" charge. The caller's human approves a top-up in Link, which mints a Shared Payment Token (spt_…); the agent builds an MPP credential from it for the challenge the DVM issued, binds the credential's SHA-256 into the signed fund request as fund.commitment, and the DVM charges the token once and books the PaymentIntent as the funding. Amounts are USD micro-units on the wire and cents on the challenge. Card credit is offered only on POST /v1/credit; /v1/job never lists or accepts method="stripe".

payment_intent_metadata.source: Server canonicalDvmId, falling back to server dvmId; never credential metadata. Host resolves DVMKIT_CANONICAL_DVM_ID with DVMKIT_DVM_ID as fallback.
payment_intent_metadata.unconfigured: dvmkit_dvm_id is omitted; standalone charging remains available
payment_intent_metadata.behavior: Sent on PaymentIntent creation, including declined confirmations; existing mpp_* metadata is preserved
